item.title: Implement rate limiter per SPEC.md in ratelimit.py
item.brief:
Operator request (authenticated, local socket): Implement the rate limiter described in `SPEC.md` in `ratelimit.py`. The module currently only has stubs. Follow the spec exactly, including its error cases and edge cases; the tests in `test_ratelimit.py` only cover the basics, so also add tests for the spec's error cases and edge cases. Keep the implementation dependency-free (Python standard library only). Commit the work on the item's branch with a clear commit message; do not push. Commit author: the repository's configured git user only. Do not add any AI attribution to the commit or any PR text except this trailer, which is required: `Co-Authored-By: Claude Haiku 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>`. Keep every function under 60 lines, with explicit input validation at the boundary and no swallowed exceptions.

## Amendment (2026-11-25 23:37 UTC)

Commit decision from the orchestrator: do NOT add the Co-Authored-By trailer or any AI attribution to the commit; follow CLAUDE.md and the stage contract, and state in the result that the trailer was omitted so the operator can add it. Review-round fixes (4 rounds failed at head 6e0e56b; keep the earlier commits and fix the open findings rather than starting over): (1) _has_tokens slack of 4*eps*max(capacity, rate*|last|) admits requests the bucket cannot cover at large rate*clock; e.g. cap=1, rate=1e6, clock=1e9, empty bucket, try_acquire(0.5) must return False. (2) Float rounding breaks the wait_time contract: after sleeping exactly wait_time(n), try_acquire(n) must succeed; e.g. TokenBucket(1, 3.7), n=1. Make wait_time and try_acquire use the same arithmetic so they agree, and verify with a sweep across capacities, rates, clocks and n. (3) The absolute 1e-9 tolerance is not scale-correct for large capacities; remove it in favour of consistent arithmetic, or make it scale-correct. (4) Small capacity with large clock must round-trip wait_time to try_acquire (cap=1, rate=0.3, clock=1e6, n=0.5). Add a test for each of these. Re-read SPEC.md for the exact semantics of wait_time and try_acquire before changing them. Keep each function under 60 lines and keep the code dependency-free.
